summary: WF Holding Ltd filed a prospectus supplement for a standby equity purchase agreement with Javelin Global Investors Limited, allowing the company to sell up to $30 million of ordinary shares over 24 months. The purchase price is set at 50% of the lowest closing price during the preceding 180 trading days, subject to a floor of $0.10. The company issued 750,000 commitment shares to the investor. This is a routine equity line financing, not a special situation. The filing does not involve a merger, acquisition, tender offer, or similar event, so it is classified as None.
